calculation_handling.description: Allowance of 1.2 m for a solar energy device above the permitted maximum height of an ancillary building containing a garden suite; a device height offset relative to another unit's limit, not a building height target.
calculation_handling.gaps: No DSL target or input for device height above another regulation's permitted maximum.

units.disclosure: Rooftop solar devices on a garden suite may rise up to 1.2 metres above the maximum height allowed for that garden suite building. This allowance is not included in the height calculation.

150.7.75.1(1).explanation: A solar panel or thermal solar device on a garden suite must meet the garden suite's minimum setbacks, and no part of it may stand more than 1.2 metres above the garden suite's permitted maximum height.
